name: shared-dictionary-remaining
reviewNotes: All 58 original glyphs reviewed. Select 35 entries: bridge-toll messages, fixed words, names and the nested spell suffix. Record 39 is the standalone noun mura (village), source b0b6; record 54 is already the Chinese-readable 道具袋 and remains unchanged. Remaining dictionary fragments require caller review before translation; zero indexed references does not prove that runtime code never uses an entry.

Dictionary reference 02ae resolves to record 14 (a802b1), nesting 02b1 at record 17 (d6f7a1). Translate both fixed phrases without modifying the caller's retained 02ae control; future integration must preserve reference indexing and validate recursive rendering.

Default hero and companion name readings are not selected here. Do not overwrite player-customized save names. Bridge toll is 100 ryo; inability to pay leads to taking the remaining money, with the source actor and amount controls retained.

Do not globally replace Japanese fragments without auditing callers. Record 30 (takara) occurs inside the causal ending in battle-effects record 98, not only as the noun treasure. Record 29 ends before the final polite syllable; records 7,11,23,28,29,30,33,34,35,37,49-53,55-57 retain original bytes pending caller-level composition review. Dictionary translations are proposals, not proof of correct sentence composition after integration.
